the read module exposes no mutating operation and records no access bookkeeping; the read-only guarantee is a responsibility of this component.

PositiveTermList, NegativeTermList and TermFrequencyEntry are computed here; ranking and the alphabetical tie-break are its responsibility. Term extraction spans both: TermExtraction owns the significant_terms operation that yields the terms, and AnalyticsRead ranks them into the lists.
one range resolution shared by summary and terms is a responsibility of the read module.
the significant-terms operation owns the 3-character minimum, the stopword constant and the accepted non-Latin limitation.

the additive v3 -> v4 migration, the three named indexes and the TD-1 fix are all inside this component. ADR-004.

the date-range control, the unbounded default and the absence of import_id/limit controls are view responsibilities.
the inline error state, the 422/500 distinction and the native-element rendering are view responsibilities.
the loading, partial-failure and superseded-response states are view responsibilities.

the read module exposes no mutating operation and issues no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL; the boundary rule is enforced by the component's dependency edge. Also rests on Persistence and Schema, which owns all DML.
the distinguishable statuses and machine codes travel through the one envelope owned by this component. Also AnalyticsRead, which refuses an inverted range without computing.
the /v1 routes, the envelope shape (one new code only) and the v1_router are owned here; the Sentiment Engine Interface gains no member.

an analytics failure is logged through the module logger; no credential and no interpolated parameter. The failure originates in the read module and is surfaced by the HTTP layer.
bounded series length, documented unbounded span and limit-bounded term-list size are all properties of the read module's computation.
